definitions.explanation: A very polite and formal way to say 'please,' used in business correspondence, formal speeches, and polite requests.

examples.japanese: {何卒|なにとぞ}⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いいたします→お願いいたします：27603_onegaiitashimasu⟧。
examples.english: I humbly ask for your kind consideration.

examples.japanese: {何卒|なにとぞ}ご⟦{了承|りょうしょう}→了承：11415_ryoushou⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
ご⟦{不便|ふべん}→不便：01501_fuben⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧おかけ⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{何卒|なにとぞ}ご⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほど⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: We apologize for the inconvenience and kindly ask for your understanding.

notes:
An archaic compound of ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧ (what) and ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ぞ (an emphatic classical particle combination). Despite its old origins, it remains very common in modern formal Japanese, especially in business.

USAGE:
Used almost exclusively in formal written and spoken contexts — business emails, official announcements, and polite customer-facing communication. It elevates the formality of a request beyond ⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧ or ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧. Rarely used in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {何卒|なにとぞ}⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いいたします→お願いいたします：27603_onegaiitashimasu⟧ — standard closing for formal requests
- {何卒|なにとぞ}ご⟦{了承|りょうしょう}→了承：11415_ryoushou⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ — please kindly understand/accept
- {何卒|なにとぞ}⟦ご{容赦|ようしゃ}→ご容赦：06969_goyousha⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ — please kindly forgive/excuse
- {何卒|なにとぞ}⟦ご{確認|かくにん}→ご確認：23544_gokakunin⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ — please kindly confirm

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧ — please; general polite usage, much less formal
- ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ — please; earnest personal requests, less formal than {何卒|なにとぞ}
- くれぐれ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ — sincerely, earnestly; emphasizes the speaker's strong wish
